_comment: FORGE frontend catalogue ENGLISH – mirror of de.json. Every key in de.json must exist here (checked by bin/i18n-check.js), including identical {placeholder} sets. Domain terms (Range, Tier, Score, Pool, PnL, APR, Out of Range) stay English in both languages. Book title and author name are never translated.

liq.tip.wallet.title: Wallet
liq.tip.wallet: Full wallet holdings including the SOL reserve for transaction fees – see Total for the amount actually available for trading.
liq.tip.total.title: Total
liq.tip.total: Wallet balance minus the SOL reserve for transaction fees (default 0.10 SOL), plus LP value and unclaimed fees. The reserve is not available as trading capital but stays in your wallet – which is why Total is lower than Wallet.
liq.tip.fee_apr_24h.title: Fee APR (24h, net)
liq.tip.fee_apr_24h: Annualised net return based on the past 24h: (Claimed Fees − Payed Fees) / baseline capital × 365. Average across all active pools.
liq.tip.payed_fees.title: Payed Fees
liq.tip.payed_fees: Total of all Solana transaction fees (in USDC) for today. Click to see individual transactions.
liq.tip.claimed_fees.title: Claimed Fees
liq.tip.claimed_fees: LP fees claimed today in USDC (regardless of reinvest/transfer).
liq.tip.fee_apr.title: Fee APR
liq.tip.fee_apr: Annualised net return based on claimed fees: (Claimed Fees − Payed Fees) / baseline capital × 365. Identical to the APR value at the top right.
liq.tip.pnl.title: PnL
liq.tip.pnl: Profit & loss: change in total portfolio value since the start of the day (00:00). Includes LP value changes, price movements and impermanent loss – across all pools.
liq.vol_mid_desc: Medium volatility – balanced between PnL and fee APR
liq.vol_high_desc: High volatility – fee-APR-weighted, PnL deliberately damped
liq.vol_rwa_desc: RWA (real-world asset) – PnL-weighted, no crypto price trend
liq.vol_norebal_desc: Rebalance-free – PnL counts heavily, low fee APR is normal here
liq.premium_waiting: Waiting for the first premium data set.
liq.premium_next_cycle: Data should be available with the next bot cycle.
liq.pool_young: Pool observed for less than 24h – time-window values are still identical.
liq.tip.chart_open: Opens the price and fee chart for this pool.
liq.tip.range_open: Opens the current price range and coin distribution of the position.
liq.tip.rebalances: Number of rebalances today. A rebalance closes the current position and reopens it with an adjusted price range.
liq.tip.signal_6h: 6h signal: price is falling faster than −0.5 %/h while the fee APR drops at the same time. Score capped at 40.
liq.tip.opp_score:
Rates the current investment quality of a pool (0–100). The main factor is PnL (is the position currently making money), plus fee APR, price trend and APR development. Weighting depends on the pool type (e.g. PnL counts more for stable/RWA pools, fee APR for highly volatile ones). Per-pool details via the score click → "Rating" tab.

≥ 60 – Good conditions, the position is worthwhile.
35–59 – Neutral, wait and see.
< 35 – Unfavourable conditions, do not invest.
liq.np_forecast: Model forecast of net return for all pools in the selected time window. Calculated from current fee APR, volatility and estimated impermanent loss using the range advisor model. Basis: 1,000 USDC. Refers to the future — not an actual measurement, shown in italics.
liq.score_inactive: Score rating not active – Opportunity Score and score limit exit are delivered via the premium data service. Trailing stop and TVL protection continue to work independently.
liq.unreliable_note: ⚠ Unreliable for volatile pools on short time windows (6h/12h)

sliq.no_premium_wallet: No premium wallet configured. It is created automatically during installation (bin/install.sh) — on an existing installation you may need to reinstall.
sliq.premium_requirements: Requirement: the current version of FORGE public. On an outdated version the premium service is deactivated automatically. If the Liquidity Bot is stopped manually, automatic payment is deactivated with it (premium delivers data specifically for this bot).
sliq.premium_explain_1: The premium service connects this bot to the FORGE public data service: automatically checked new pool offers (address, token, fee tier verified against the chain), continuous market scoring/scanner data for pool rating, and priority support contact.
sliq.premium_explain_2: The cost is settled automatically every hour from the premium wallet stored here (separate from the bot capital) — as long as the balance lasts and the service is activated below.
sliq.premium_explain_3: This premium service is tailored to the Liquidity Bot and is managed and paid for independently of other bots.
sliq.premium_on_first_payment: Premium service activated – first payment sent, data will be up to date shortly
sliq.offers_intro: Pools checked by the premium data service that this bot does not know yet. Adopting only makes the pool known — no capital is ever invested in the process.
sliq.offer_exception_hint: ⚠️ This pool triggers a technical stop criterion (Token-2022 and/or adaptive fees), but has explicitly been approved as an exception:
sliq.offer_rejected_hint: ❌ At least one delivered value does not match the chain. This pool cannot be adopted.
sliq.offer_unsupported_hint: ⚠️ This pool meets a technical stop criterion without an accepted exception and is not supported.
sliq.adopt_explain_1: Adopting makes this pool known to the bot (deactivated, no cleanup reinvest).
sliq.adopt_explain_2: No capital is invested in the process.
sliq.adopt_explain_3: Releasing it for real capital happens separately afterwards via "Activate pool", just like for every other pool.
sliq.manual_desc: Invests the wallet balance into a pool of your choice.
sliq.manual_tip: Invests the entire investable wallet balance once into the pool selected here – regardless of the Opportunity Score. This pool becomes the new cleanup target until you choose something else here or in the "Best pool" tab.
sliq.best_pool_desc: Automatic, recurring investment into the pool with the highest Opportunity Score.
sliq.best_pool_tip: Runs every full hour: invests the wallet balance automatically into the pool with the highest Opportunity Score – provided it reaches the minimum score threshold. Only available with an activated premium service (the Opportunity Score is calculated centrally).
sliq.premium_only: Only available with an activated premium service (the Opportunity Score is calculated centrally).
sliq.best_pool_hint: — invests into the pool with the highest InvestScore
sliq.min_deposit_tip: Cleanup only invests if at least this amount of investable USDC value is in the wallet.||Example: minimum 10 USDC, but only 9 USDC of value in the wallet → nothing happens.||Leave empty or 0 = no minimum.
sliq.max_deposit_tip: Limits how much USDC may be invested into the best pool per cleanup run.||Example: 2,350 USDC in the wallet, limit 500 USDC → at most 500 USDC is deposited per run; the rest stays liquid.||Leave empty or 0 = no limit.
sliq.dust_desc: Automatically swaps small token remainders to USDC at the end of every cleanup run.
sliq.dust_tip: After every cleanup run small remainders of known pool tokens are often left in the wallet (e.g. amounts that do not divide exactly after a swap). The dust sweep swaps these remainders to USDC automatically so they do not sit around unused. The lower and upper bound define which value counts as "dust".
sliq.dust_range_hint: Remainders in this range are swapped to USDC automatically after every cleanup. Below: negligible, left alone. Above: left alone, a regular investment follows.
sliq.dust_min_lt_max: The lower bound must be smaller than the upper bound.
sliq.dust_min_lt_max_zero: The lower bound must be smaller than the upper bound (both ≥ 0).
sliq.cleanup_running: Cleanup running… (may take up to 5 min)
sliq.sol_low_premium: Not enough SOL in the premium wallet for the hourly payment.
sliq.premium_active_tip: Premium data service active – Opportunity Score and score-limit exit run on delivered data.
sliq.premium_inactive_tip: Score rating not active – Opportunity Score and score-limit exit are delivered by the premium data service. Trailing Stop and TVL protection keep working independently.
sliq.dryrun_pending_tip: The automatic test run (deposit.js --dry-run) is still going – waiting for the first pool data (~1 bot cycle after adoption).
sliq.cannot_deactivate_tip: The pool holds an open position. Withdraw everything first, then deactivate.
sliq.range_tip: Shows the current position range and allows a manual rebalance (the position is closed and reopened with a new range).
sliq.range_summary: Show the range and rebalance manually.
sliq.fee_claim_summary: Governs how fee income is handled.
sliq.risk_tip: Two independent protection mechanisms:||Score Limit: closes the position automatically as soon as the pool's Opportunity Score falls below an adjustable threshold.||Trailing Stop (TS): closes the position when the pool value falls a configurable percentage below the previous high-water mark.||With both mechanisms the withdrawn capital can optionally be swapped to USDC and sent to an address.
sliq.deposit_refpool: Price reference pool – deposits not possible
sliq.pool_deactivated_tip: The pool is deactivated – activate it first, then deposit.
sliq.no_pool_data_hint: No reliable pool data yet – check the "Status" row above to see whether the Liquidity Bot is running.
sliq.pool_off_hint: 🔒 Pool deactivated – it takes no capital (no cleanup reinvest) until it is activated again. Settings can still be saved.
sliq.pool_idle_hint: ⚠ Pool idle – no open position. Settings can still be saved.
sliq.pool_types_hint: Saving applies the values of a row immediately to ALL pools of that type and overwrites existing individual settings there (risk management modal).

sliq.pool_disable_hint: No more capital is invested into the pool (no cleanup reinvest, no deposit) until it is activated again.
sliq.risk_summary_tip: Rules to limit losses and secure gains.

sliq.tvl_stage1_tip: The stage the protection normally runs on: if the pool TVL falls below this value, the configured share is withdrawn — preset to 100 % and swapped to USDC.||Its threshold must be higher than the one on stage 2.
sliq.tvl_stage2_tip: Optional second stage for a staggered exit (lower threshold). Off by default — then only stage 1 reacts.||If both stages are active, the threshold here must be lower than on stage 1 and both shares must add up to 100 %.
sliq.tvl1_err: Stage 1: the TVL threshold must be greater than 0.
sliq.tvl2_err: Stage 2: the TVL threshold must be greater than 0.

sliq.wallet_read_failed_retry: The wallet balance could not be read. Please try again.
sliq.fee_claim_tip:
Controls from which amount fees are claimed and what happens to them afterwards.

Auto compounding: reinvest fees into the pool right away (fully or partially).

Send to: optionally send remaining fees to an address – swapping to USDC first if needed.
sliq.deposit_tip:
Adds capital to the existing pool position, or opens a new position if the pool is currently inactive.

Two modes:
• USDC amount: wallet USDC is swapped into both pool tokens.
• Wallet coins: existing pool tokens are used directly, no swap.
sliq.withdraw_tip:
Removes liquidity from the existing pool position. Optionally the withdrawn coins can be swapped to USDC and/or sent to an address before they stay in the wallet.

Two modes:
• USDC value: liquidity worth this USDC amount is removed proportionally.
• Token amount: proportional removal anchored on one pool token — both sides come back proportionally.
sliq.cleanup_consider_tip: If this option is enabled, the pool takes part in the hourly cleanup in "best pool" mode.||If it is disabled, the pool is skipped there — even if it had the highest Opportunity Score. Manual pool selection is unaffected.
sliq.sim_tip: Expected or measured value development of the LP position with a stake of 1,000 USDC.||measured: real snapshot values (active pools only)|projection: extrapolated linearly from total return p.a.|simulation: from model APR for inactive pools
sliq.total_return_tip: Expected annual return of the position:|realized APR from fees|− rebalance cost|− reinvest efficiency loss|± token value movement|||The token value movement can be positive or negative. If the value of the held tokens falls, the total return tips into the negative — even when fees are doing well.
sliq.confidence_tip: Data maturity of the scorer: how many days of fee_history exist?|Scales from 0 % (3 days) to 100 % (14+ days).|Below 3 days: the pool automatically lands in "hold" (no invest signal).|Inactive pools: 60 % at most (APR estimated, not measured).
sliq.token_value_tip: Annualised change of the LP value in USDC over the last days (max 7 d).|Captures token price movements — complementary to the fee view (realized APR).|With sharply falling tokens this value can become clearly negative, even when fees are doing well.
sliq.pnl1d_tip: LP value change over the last 24 hours.|Acute indicator for sudden price crashes.|Trigger for "withdraw": if the value drops by more than 10 %, the pool is marked withdraw immediately (hysteresis still has to agree).
sliq.min_amount_tip: Fees are only claimed once their total value has reached this amount.
sliq.reinvest_share_tip: Share of the claimed fees that is reinvested into the pool right away. The rest stays in the wallet or is forwarded via "send to".
sliq.fc_swap_tip: Automatically swap remaining coins to USDC before the transfer.
sliq.ts_tip: Trails the stop value dynamically: every new pool high (high-water mark) is remembered. If the current pool value falls the configured percentage below the HWM, the position is closed.||Snapshot source: position_snapshots (every 5-10 min, lp_value_usd incl. open fees).||One-off action — no automatic re-entry. Cleanup in "best pool" mode reinvests the free capital on the next run.||The HWM is reset when a new position is opened.
sliq.pool_min_value_tip: If the pool amount falls below this USDC amount, it is closed.||Tip: useful as absolute capital protection, independent of the percentage drawdown.
sliq.drawdown_tip: Applies from entry. Recommended: 25–40 %. The position is closed once, in full.||Deliberately wide: right after entry, normal fluctuation should not trigger an exit.||Without a send address the coins stay in the wallet and the next cleanup run in "best pool" mode reinvests them automatically.
sliq.ts_swap_tip: Automatically swap coins to USDC after withdrawal.
sliq.ts_cooldown_tip: After a liquidation by the Trailing Stop this pool is blocked from automated cleanup assignments for the configured time.||Manual deposits remain possible at any time.||Cooldown start: the moment of liquidation.
sliq.score_limit_tip: If the pool's Opportunity Score falls below the configured threshold, the entire capital is withdrawn automatically.||The score is shown and compared WITHOUT the volume penalty – that penalty must never trigger an exit, so the value shown here can differ from the dashboard score.||Zero score (missing data) → no trigger.||One-off action – no automatic re-entry.
sliq.score_limit_rec_tip: Recommendation: threshold 25–35. The position is closed completely, once.||Without a send address the coins stay in the wallet and the next cleanup run in "best pool" mode reinvests them automatically.
sliq.sl_cooldown_tip: After a liquidation by the Score Limit this pool is blocked from automated cleanup assignments for the configured time.||Manual deposits remain possible at any time.||Cooldown start: the moment of liquidation.
sliq.tvl_threshold_tip: Pool TVL in USDC. If the value falls below this, the action takes effect.
sliq.tvl_action_tip: Share of the capital that is pulled out of the pool when the threshold is undercut.||If both stages are active, the two actions must add up to 100 % – stage 2 is completed automatically.
sliq.tvl_at_activation_tip: Pool TVL at the time of the first deposit into this pool. Serves as a reference for the thresholds below.
sliq.current_tvl_tip: Current total value locked of the pool (dashboard value).
sliq.tvl_swap_tip: Automatically swap coins to USDC after every withdrawal (stage 1 and stage 2).
sliq.tvl_sendto_tip: Recipient address for the withdrawn capital (applies to both stages).||Without an address the capital stays in the wallet.
sliq.tvl_cooldown_tip: After a partial TVL protection withdrawal the pool is blocked from automated cleanup assignments for the configured time.||With a 100 % withdrawal the pool is empty anyway.
sliq.slider_deposit_tip: The slider selects the share of the economic maximum. When depositing, the limiting pair is used at the current pool ratio (a tolerance for price movement is built in). No swap.
sliq.slider_withdraw_tip: The slider selects the percentage share of the position to withdraw. Both tokens are removed proportionally (LP ratio). No swap.
sliq.pw_swap_tip: Automatically swap withdrawn coins to USDC before they stay in the wallet (or before sending).
sliq.balance_critical: Critical: balance lasts ~{hours}h – please top up soon.

health.legend_warn: Degraded – service responds, but slowly or with errors
health.legend_unknown: Unknown – check ran, status could not be determined
health.legend_disabled: Disabled – service deliberately switched off, not an error
health.legend_nodata: No data – no check was recorded during this hour
health.legend_note_bars:
Each bar shows 168 hours (7 days).
Left = oldest entries, right = current.
health.legend_note_host: Under Host the same four states are called Normal, Tight, Critical and Unknown – there it is not about reachability but about metrics of the server.
health.no_measurement_7d: no data – no valid measurement in 7 days
health.ex_svc_warn: The service responds, but only partially – slowly, with errors, or deliberately stopped.
health.ex_svc_unknown: The state could not be determined – the measurement was invalid.
health.ex_svc_disabled: This service is switched off – there is nothing to monitor until it is switched on. Not an error, but the intended state.
health.ex_host_ok: The metric is within the safe range.
health.ex_host_warn: The metric is getting tight. Not a problem yet, but the reserve is shrinking.
health.ex_host_error: The metric is critical – action is required here.
health.ex_host_unknown: The metric could not be determined.

From then on it replaces drawdown 1 — still measured from the high-water mark.||Example (drawdown 1 = 2 %, drawdown 2 = 1 %): if the value rises 3 %, stage 2 arms; the exit then sits 1 % below the high, locking in 2 % profit.||Must be smaller than drawdown 1. Once armed, it stays armed until the position closes.
